report.summary: Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) re-quoting SELL 3784 / BUY 756 every ~3s, with both sides cancelled in the same instant and re-priced to follow the touch as it drifted from 9997 to 9991. The SELL quotes executed 7324 in total; the trader had no BUY execution at all, so there is no opposite-side benefit. The detector text describes SELL executions against BUY cancels, but the tape shows the fills were on the SELL quotes themselves. No single order reached 3x depth (max 1.31x). No public event, no repetition flag. Closing as market making.

response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.80. It is a proposal only, and a human analyst decides.

**The three facts that drove it:**
1. T-X0917-04 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. The trader re-quotes SELL 3784 and BUY 756 about every 3 seconds. Both sides are cancelled in the same instant and re-priced with the touch, as it drifts from 9997 to 9991.
2. There is no opposite-side execution. The only fills, 7324 in total, were on the trader's own SELL quotes. The trader had no BUY fills, so feature (b), a benefit from an opposite-side execution, is absent. The detector text describes SELL executions against BUY cancels, but the tape doesn't show that.
3. No single order reached 3x depth (the maximum was 1.31x). There was no public event, no risk event, no repetition flag and no prior alerts. The order-to-trade ratio was 9.6 against a typical 35.

**What would change my mind:** Any BUY execution on this trader's account in the window would change it. So would evidence that the SELL quotes were placed to push the touch down before a BUY. The soft spot is the cancel symmetry of 0.355, because the SELL and BUY quote sizes differ.
